# SMSF newsroom

Read the latest updates on tax, super and registry services for self-managed super funds (SMSFs) and approved auditors.

If you haven't already, subscribe to our monthly newsletter and we'll send you regular news updates.

Using keywords, you can search for recent articles of interest.

### ATO Community

Find tax and super answers with ATO Community.

[ATO Community](https://community.ato.gov.au/s/ "ATO Community")

[**Commissioner-initiated assessments under Payday Super**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/commissioner-initiated-assessments-under-payday-super)

Our draft guidance PS LA 2026/D4 is open for consultation until 13 November 2026.

22 October 2026

[**Avoid delays when responding to release authorities**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/avoid-delays-when-responding-to-release-authorities)

Using the correct payment reference number helps us match your release authority payment and avoid processing delays.

22 October 2026

[**Your electronic service address (ESA) must be up to date**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/your-electronic-service-address-must-be-up-to-date)

Your self-managed super fund needs to have an active ESA to comply with Payday Super and SuperStream.

19 October 2026

[**SMSF members may now use the First Home Super Saver Scheme**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/smsf-members-may-now-use-the-first-home-super-saver-scheme)

The FHSS scheme supports your members on the path to home ownership. Find out the latest information for SMSF funds.

16 October 2026

[**Have your say on LRBA guidance updates**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/have-your-say-on-lrba-guidance-updates)

Review draft LRBA guidance updates and provide feedback by 13 November.

9 October 2026

[**Division 296 tax the latest for SMSFs**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/division-296-tax-the-latest-for-smsfs)

Here is the latest information for Division 296 reporting for SMSFs.

24 September 2026

[**Downsizer contributions offer a valuable boost to retirement savings**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/downsizer-contributions-offer-a-valuable-boost-to-retirement-savings)

Downsizer super contributions can help eligible Australians boost their super using proceeds from the sale of their home.

14 September 2026

[**TBARs for September quarter are due on 28 October**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/tbars-for-september-quarter-are-due-on-28-october)

If your SMSF had transfer balance account events in the September quarter you must lodge a TBAR by 28 October 2026.

10 September 2026

[**Highlights: SMSF quarterly statistical report June 2026**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/highlights-smsf-quarterly-statistical-report-june-2026)

Read the highlights from our June 2026 quarterly statistical report on self-managed super funds (SMSFs).

8 September 2026

[**Get your SMSF audits off to a strong start**](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-newsroom/get-your-smsf-audits-off-to-a-strong-start)

Check independence, evidence and reporting risks early to resolve issues before finalising an SMSF audit.

7 September 2026

Report webpage issue
